name: JSON Ad Filter
description: Strips ad and tracking entries out of JSON API responses via a registered content transformer
author: Revamp

rules.description: Filtering rules applied to matching JSON responses, in order

urlPattern.description: Substring (or * wildcard) matched against the full URL; omit or "*" to match every URL

path.description: Dotted path from the JSON root; [*] on a segment fans out over array elements (mid or final), e.g. "data.items[*]"

field.description: Dotted field path inside the matched node the predicate is evaluated on

contains.description: Substring (for strings) or membership (for arrays) predicate value

action.description: remove = delete the array item / object key, null = replace with null, empty = replace with []/{}/"" by type
